translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, his birthday, Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，以左丞相昂爲太尉、樞密使，右丞相張浩爲左丞相兼侍中，樞密使僕散思恭爲右丞相兼中書令。

translations.literal: Second month, on renwu, Left Grand Councilor Ang was made Grand Marshal and privy commissioner; Right Grand Councilor Zhang Hao was made left grand councilor and concurrently palace attendant; Privy Commissioner Pusan Sigong was made right grand councilor and concurrently director of the Zhongshu office.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renwu, left grand councilor Ang became grand marshal and privy commissioner; right grand councilor Zhang Hao became left grand councilor and palace attendant; privy commissioner Pusan Sigong became right grand councilor and Zhongshu director.

sentences.zh: 尚書左丞張中孚罷，右丞張暉爲平章政事。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director Zhang Zhongfu was dismissed; Right Vice Director Zhang Hui was made grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Left vice director Zhang Zhongfu was removed; right vice director Zhang Hui was made grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 參知政事劉萼爲左丞，參知政事蕭頤爲右丞，吏部尚書蔡松年爲參知政事。

translations.literal: Participation Councillor Liu E was made left vice director; Participation Councillor Xiao Yi was made right vice director; Minister of Personnel Cai Songnian was made participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Participation councillor Liu E became left vice director; participation councillor Xiao Yi became right vice director; minister of personnel Cai Songnian became participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子，以左丞相張浩、平章政事張暉每見僧法寶必坐其下，失大臣體，各杖二十。

translations.literal: Third month, on renzi, because Left Grand Councilor Zhang Hao and Grand Councilor Zhang Hui always sat below the monk Fabao whenever they met him, losing ministerial decorum, each was flogged twenty strokes.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renzi, left grand councilor Zhang Hao and grand councilor Zhang Hui were flogged twenty strokes each for seating themselves below the monk Fabao whenever they met him—conduct unworthy of chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 僧法寶妄自尊大，杖二百。

translations.literal: The monk Fabao, arrogantly setting himself above others, was flogged two hundred strokes.
translations.idiomatic: The monk Fabao, who had presumed on his standing, received two hundred strokes.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，命以大房山雲峰寺爲山陵，建行宮其麓。

translations.literal: On yimao it was ordered that Yunfeng Temple on Dafang Mountain serve as the mountain tomb and that a traveling palace be built at its foot.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the court designated Yunfeng Temple on Dafang Mountain as the mountain mausoleum and ordered a lodge built at the foot of the slope.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以左司郎中李通爲賀宋生日使。

translations.literal: On gengwu Left Bureau Director Li Tong was made envoy to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Li Tong of the left bureau was sent as birthday envoy to Song.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑朔，昏霧四塞，日無光，凡十有七日。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on dingchou, new-moon day, murky fog closed in on every side; the sun gave no light—for seventeen days in all.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on dingchou, the fourth month’s new moon, a dull haze shut out the sky and the sun failed for seventeen days straight.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on dingwei, new-moon day, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingwei, the new moon brought a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，南京大內火。

translations.literal: On guichou fire broke out in the Southern Capital inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou fire swept the inner palace at the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，命判大宗正事京等如上京，奉遷太祖、太宗梓宮。

translations.literal: On yimao Associate Director of the Imperial Clan Court Jing and others were ordered to Shangjing to escort the coffins of Taizu and Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Jing, associate director of the Imperial Clan Court, and others were sent to Shangjing to bring down the coffins of Taizu and Taizong.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，如大房山，營山陵。

translations.literal: On bingyin he went to Dafang Mountain to lay out the mountain tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he went to Dafang Mountain to survey the mountain tomb.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌，登寶昌門觀角抵，百姓縱觀。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on bingxu, he ascended Baochang Gate to watch sumo; commoners were allowed to look on freely.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingxu, he mounted Baochang Gate to watch sumo while the people were let crowd the streets to watch.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命右丞相僕散思恭、大宗正丞胡拔魯如上京，奉遷山陵及迎永壽宮皇太后。

translations.literal: On yiwei Right Grand Councilor Pusan Sigong and Imperial Clan Court associate director Hubalu were ordered to Shangjing to escort the mountain tomb and to welcome the empress dowager of Yongshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei right grand councilor Pusan Sigong and imperial-clan associate director Hubalu were sent to Shangjing to move the mountain tomb and escort the Yongshou Palace empress dowager home.

sentences.zh: 七月癸丑，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on guichou, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on guichou, Venus shone in broad daylight—an omen.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，如大房山，杖提舉營造官吏部尚書耶律安禮等。

translations.literal: On xinyou he went to Dafang Mountain and flogged Minister of Works Yelü Anli and others who supervised the construction.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he returned to Dafang Mountain and had Minister of Works Yelü Anli and the building supervisors beaten.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，還宮。

translations.literal: On yihai he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午，如大房山。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on renwu, he went to Dafang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renwu, he went again to Dafang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 甲申，啟土，賜役夫，人絹一匹。

translations.literal: On jiashen the ground was broken; corvée laborers were rewarded, one bolt of silk per man.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the earth was opened for the tomb; each laborer received one bolt of silk.

sentences.zh: 是日，還宮。

translations.literal: That day he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: That same day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 甲午，遣平章政事蕭玉迎祭祖宗梓宮于廣寧。

translations.literal: On jiawu Grand Councilor Xiao Yu was sent to Guangning to receive and sacrifice to the ancestral coffins.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu grand councilor Xiao Yu went to Guangning to meet the ancestral coffins and perform the welcoming rites.

sentences.zh: 乙未，增置教坊人數。

translations.literal: On yiwei the establishment of the Music Bureau was increased.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the court enlarged the Music Bureau roster.

sentences.zh: 庚子，杖左宣徽使敬嗣暉、同知宣徽事烏居仁及尚食官。

translations.literal: On gengzi Left Palace Ennoblement Commissioner Jing Sihui, Associate Commissioner of Palace Ennoblement Wuju Ren, and the catering officials were flogged.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Jing Sihui, left commissioner of palace ennoblement, Wuju Ren, his associate, and the catering staff were beaten.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，平章政事張輝迎祭梓宮于宗州。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on wushen, Grand Councilor Zhang Hui received and sacrificed to the coffins at Zongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wushen, grand councilor Zhang Hui met the coffins at Zongzhou and led the offering rites.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，上謂宰臣及左司官曰：「朝廷之事，尤在慎密。

translations.literal: On yimao the emperor told the grand councilors and left-bureau officials: “Court business above all demands secrecy.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the emperor told the grand councilors and left-bureau staff, “State affairs demand secrecy above all else.

sentences.zh: 昨授張中孚、趙慶襲官，除書未到，先已知之，皆汝等泄之也。

translations.literal: Yesterday, when Zhang Zhongfu and Zhao Qing were granted hereditary offices, you knew of it before the appointment documents arrived—you leaked it.
translations.idiomatic: Yesterday, when Zhang Zhongfu and Zhao Qing were given hereditary posts, word reached you before the commissions did—you are the ones who leaked it.

sentences.zh: 敢復爾者，殺無赦。

translations.literal: If anyone dares do so again, death without pardon.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who dares do that again will be killed without mercy.

sentences.zh: 」己未，如大房山。

translations.literal: ” On jiwei he went to Dafang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: ” On jiwei he went to Dafang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 庚申，還宮。

translations.literal: On gengshen he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以殿前都點檢納合椿年爲參知政事。

translations.literal: On bingyin the Palace Director of the Front Hall Nahe Chunnian was made participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Nahe Chunnian, director of the front hall of the palace guard, was made participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上親迎梓宮及皇太后于沙流河，命左右持杖二束，跽太后前，曰：「某不孝，久失溫凊，願痛笞之。

translations.literal: On dingmao the emperor went in person to the Shaliu River to welcome the imperial coffin and the empress dowager; he ordered attendants to hold two bundles of rods, knelt before the empress dowager, and said: “I have been unfilial, long failing in warmth and care; I beg to be beaten severely.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the emperor went in person to the Shaliu River to meet the coffin and the empress dowager; attendants carried two bundles of rods as he knelt before her and said, “I have been unfilial, long neglecting your comfort; beat me as you will.

sentences.zh: 」太后掖起之，曰：「凡民有子克家，猶愛之，況我有子如此。

translations.literal: ” The empress dowager raised him up and said: “When common folk have a son who can keep the household, they still love him—how much more when I have such a son as this.
translations.idiomatic: ” The empress dowager lifted him up and said, “Ordinary people love a son who can keep the house—how could I not love a son like you?

sentences.zh: 」叱持杖者退。

translations.literal: ” She ordered those holding the rods to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: ” She ordered the rod-bearers away.

sentences.zh: 庚午，獵，親射麞以薦梓宮。

translations.literal: On gengwu he hunted and personally shot a roe deer to offer before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he hunted and shot a roe deer himself as an offering before the coffin.

sentences.zh: 壬申，至自沙流河。

translations.literal: On renshen he returned from the Shaliu River.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he came back from the Shaliu River.

sentences.zh: 十月丙子，皇太后至中都，居壽康宮。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on bingzi, the empress dowager reached the Central Capital and took up residence in Shoukang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on bingzi, the empress dowager entered the Central Capital and lodged in Shoukang Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，權奉安太廟神主于延聖寺，致奠梓宮于東郊，舉哀。

translations.literal: On wuyin the ancestral spirit tablets were provisionally enshrined at Yansheng Temple; sacrifice was offered to the coffin in the eastern suburb, and mourning cries were raised.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the spirit tablets of the ancestral temple were lodged for the time being at Yansheng Temple; offerings were made to the coffin in the eastern suburb amid wailing.

sentences.zh: 己卯，梓宮至中都，以大安殿爲丕承殿，安置。

translations.literal: On jimao the coffin reached the Central Capital; the Great Peace Hall was renamed the Picheng Hall and used for its placement.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the coffin entered the Central Capital; the Great Peace Hall was renamed Picheng Hall and set aside for it.

sentences.zh: 壬午，命省部諸司便服治事，不奏死刑一月。

translations.literal: On renwu the ministries and agencies were ordered to conduct business in ordinary dress and not to report capital cases for one month.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the court ordered every ministry and agency to work in plain dress and to submit no capital cases for a month.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，告于丕承殿。

translations.literal: On xinmao announcement was made at Picheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the court made announcement at Picheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 乙未，如菆宮，冊諡永甯皇太后曰慈憲皇后。

translations.literal: On yimao, he went to the Cao Palace and enshrined the posthumous title of Empress Dowager Yongning as Empress Cixian.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he went to the Cao Palace and gave Empress Dowager Yongning the posthumous title Empress Cixian.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，大房山行宮成，名曰磐寧。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the touring palace at Mount Dafang was completed; it was named Panning.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the touring palace on Mount Dafang was finished and named Panning.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，還宮。

translations.literal: On wuxu, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以翰林學士承旨耶律歸一等爲賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: On jihai, Hanlin academician bearer Yelü Guiyi and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Yelü Guiyi, bearer of the Hanlin Academy, and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉朔，改元正隆，大赦。

translations.literal: Second month, on guiyou, new-moon day, the era name was changed to Zhenglong and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guiyou, the new moon, the reign was retitled Zhenglong and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，御宣華門觀迎佛，賜諸寺僧絹五百匹、彩五十段、銀五百兩。

translations.literal: On gengchen, he viewed the Buddha-welcoming ceremony at the Xuanhua Gate and bestowed five hundred bolts of silk, fifty lengths of brocade, and five hundred taels of silver on the monks of the monasteries.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he watched the Buddha-welcoming rite at the Xuanhua Gate and gave the temples five hundred bolts of silk, fifty lengths of brocade, and five hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，改定內外諸司印記。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the seals of inner and outer offices were revised.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the court revised the seals of every inner and outer office.

sentences.zh: 乙未，司徒張通古致仕。

translations.literal: On yimao, Grand Mentor Zhang Tonggu retired.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Grand Mentor Zhang Tonggu left office.

sentences.zh: 庚子，謁山陵。

translations.literal: On gengzi, he paid respects at the mountain tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he went to worship at the mountain tombs.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，還都。

translations.literal: On xinchou, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 三月壬寅朔，始定職事官朝參等格。

translations.literal: Third month, on renchen, new-moon day, regulations for court attendance by office-holders were first set.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renchen, the new moon, the court first fixed the rules for officials’ attendance at audience.

sentences.zh: 仍罷兵衛。

translations.literal: The military guards were also abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The military-guard office was abolished as well.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以左宣徽使敬嗣暉等爲賀宋生日使。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Left Xuanhui Commissioner Jing Sihui and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Jing Sihui, left commissioner of the Xuanhui Court, and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on the birthday.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，如大房山行視山陵。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on dingchou, he went to the touring palace on Mount Dafang to inspect the mountain tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingchou, he went to the Mount Dafang touring palace to view the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 十月乙酉，葬始祖以下十帝于大房山。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on yiyou, the ten emperors from the Founder downward were buried at Mount Dafang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on yiyou, the ten ancestral emperors from the Founder down were interred at Mount Dafang.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，還宮。

translations.literal: On dingyou, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 閏月己亥朔，山陵禮成，群臣稱賀。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on jihai, new-moon day, the mountain-tomb rites were completed and the ministers offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the intercalary month’s new moon, the tomb rites were finished and the ministers congratulated the throne.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，回鶻使使寅朮烏籠骨來貢。

translations.literal: On jiachen, the Uighur envoy Yinzhu Wulungu came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the Uighur envoy Yinzhu Wulungu arrived with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，杖右丞相蕭玉、左丞蔡松年、右丞耶律安禮、御史中丞馬諷等。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Right Chancellor Xiao Yu, Left Vice Director Cai Songnian, Right Vice Director Yelü Anli, and Censor-in-Chief Ma Feng were caned.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Right Chancellor Xiao Yu, Left Vice Director Cai Songnian, Right Vice Director Yelü Anli, and Censor-in-Chief Ma Feng were flogged.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳朔，以右司郎中梁銶等爲賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jisi, new-moon day, Right Bureau Director Liang Quan and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jisi, the new moon, Right Bureau Director Liang Quan and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，禁二月八日迎佛。

translations.literal: On guisi, welcoming the Buddha on the eighth day of the second month was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the court forbade Buddha-welcoming rites on the eighth day of the second month.

sentences.zh: 二年正月戊辰朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Second year, first month, on wuchen, new-moon day, Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on wuchen, the first month’s new moon, Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent New Year envoys.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Venus was visible in the daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Venus shone in broad daylight—an omen.

sentences.zh: 癸未，生辰，宋、高麗夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On guiwei, his birthday; Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, his birthday, Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以工部侍郎韓錫同知宣徽院事，錫不謝，杖百二十，奪所授官。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Vice Minister of Works Han Xi was made concurrent knower of Xuanhui Court affairs; Xi did not perform thanks, was caned one hundred and twenty strokes, and stripped of his appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Han Xi, vice minister of works, was named to oversee the Xuanhui Court; he refused the thanksgiving rite, took one hundred and twenty strokes of the rod, and lost the post.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，初定太廟時享牲牢禮儀。

translations.literal: Second month, on xinchou, the ritual of seasonal offerings at the Imperial Ancestor Temple was first fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinchou, the court first set the seasonal offerings and sacrificial livestock for the Imperial Ancestor Temple.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，改定親王以下封爵等第，命置局追取存亡告身，存者二品以上，死者一品，參酌削降。

translations.literal: On guimao, the ranks of enfeoffment below imperial princes were revised; a bureau was ordered to collect surviving and deceased patents of appointment—living holders of the second rank and above, deceased of the first rank—and consider reductions.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao noble ranks below imperial princes were reworked; officials were told to gather patents, living or dead, and cut back those who had held second rank or higher in life, or first rank after death.

sentences.zh: 公私文書，但有王爵字者，皆立限毀抹，雖墳墓碑誌併發而毀之。

translations.literal: In official and private documents, wherever characters for kingly titles appeared, all were to be obliterated within a set term; even tomb epitaphs were dug up and destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Any official or private writing that bore a royal title had to be scraped clean within a deadline—even tomb inscriptions were unearthed and defaced.

sentences.zh: 三月丙寅朔，高麗遣使賀受尊號。

translations.literal: Third month, on bingyin, new-moon day, Goryeo sent an envoy to congratulate the receipt of an honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingyin, the new moon, Goryeo sent an envoy to hail the new honorific.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑，以宿直將軍僕散烏里黑爲夏國生日使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on yichou, Night-Duty General Pusan Wulihai was made birthday envoy to Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yichou, Night-Duty General Pusan Wulihai was sent as birthday envoy to Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 戊子，罷護駕軍，置龍翔虎步軍。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the Escort Army was abolished and the Dragon Soar and Tiger Step armies were established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the Escort Army was disbanded and the Dragon Soar and Tiger Step corps were created.

sentences.zh: 罷尚書省文資令史出爲外官。

translations.literal: Secretariat document clerks were barred from going out as external officials.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat clerks on document duty were no longer sent out to serve as local officials.

sentences.zh: 是秋，中都、山東、河東蝗。

translations.literal: That autumn, locusts struck the Central Capital, Shandong, and Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn locusts ravaged the Central Capital, Shandong, and Hedong.

sentences.zh: 十月壬寅，命會寧府毀舊宮殿、諸大族第宅及儲慶寺，仍夷其址而耕種之。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on renchen, Huining Prefecture was ordered to destroy the old palaces, mansions of great clans, and Chuqing Temple, level the sites, and plant crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on renchen, Huining was told to raze the old palaces, great-family mansions, and Chuqing Temple, level the ground, and put it under the plow.

sentences.zh: 丁未，禁賣古器入他境。

translations.literal: On dingwei, selling antiquities across the border was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the export of antiquities beyond the frontier was banned.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，初鑄銅錢。

translations.literal: On yimao, copper cash was cast for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the court cast copper coin for the first time.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，以侍衛親軍副指揮使高助不古等爲賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on xinwei, Deputy Commander of the Personal Guard Gao Zhubugu and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinwei, Deputy Commander of the Personal Guard Gao Zhubugu and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥，以侍衛親軍都指揮使紇石烈良弼爲參知政事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jihai, Personal Guard Commander Heshilie Liangbi was made participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jihai, Personal Guard Commander Heshilie Liangbi was made participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 三年正月壬戌朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Third year, first month, on renxu, new-moon day, Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on renxu, the first month’s new moon, Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent New Year envoys.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，子矧思阿不死，殺太醫副使謝友正及其乳母等。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the son Shensi Abu died; Vice Medical Officer Xie Youzheng and his wet nurses were put to death.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Prince Shensi Abu died; the emperor had Vice Medical Officer Xie Youzheng and the wet nurses executed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，生辰，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On dingchou, his birthday; Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, his birthday, Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 己卯，杖右諫議大夫楊伯雄。

translations.literal: On jimao, Right Remonstrance Official Yang Boxiong was caned.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Right Remonstrance Official Yang Boxiong was flogged.

sentences.zh: 二月壬辰朔，都城及京兆初置錢監。

translations.literal: Second month, on renchen, new-moon day, mints were first established at the capital and Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renchen, the new moon, the capital and Jingzhao first gained mints.

sentences.zh: 甲午，遣使檢視隨路金銀銅鐵冶。

translations.literal: On jiawu, envoys were dispatched to inspect gold, silver, copper, and iron smelters along the routes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu agents were sent to survey gold, silver, copper, and iron works on every circuit.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉朔，司天奏日食，侯之不見。

translations.literal: Third month, on xinyou, new-moon day, the Bureau of Astronomy reported a solar eclipse; they waited but did not see it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinyou, the new moon, the Bureau of Astronomy predicted an eclipse, but the sky showed none.

sentences.zh: 命自今遇日食，面奏，不須頒告。

translations.literal: It was ordered that henceforth, when an eclipse occurred, it should be reported in person at audience and need not be proclaimed by edict.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, on an eclipse the astronomers were to report face to face at court and were not to issue a public notice.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以兵部尚書蕭恭等爲賀宋生日使。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Minister of War Xiao Gong and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Minister of War Xiao Gong and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on the birthday.

sentences.zh: 四月丙辰，樞密副使烏古論當海罷，以北京留守張暉爲樞密副使。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on bingchen, Vice Privy Commissioner Wugulun Danghai was dismissed; Beijing defender Zhang Hui was made vice privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on bingchen, Vice Privy Commissioner Wugulun Danghai was removed and Beijing defender Zhang Hui made vice privy commissioner in his place.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，蝗入京師。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on renchen, locusts entered the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renchen, locusts swarmed into the capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉，以工部尚書蘇保衡等爲賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on xinyou, Minister of Works Su Baoheng and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinyou, Minister of Works Su Baoheng and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔有司勤政安民。

translations.literal: On guihai, an edict ordered the officials to govern diligently and settle the people.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai an edict charged every office to govern diligently and keep the people at peace.

sentences.zh: 癸未，尚書左丞耶律安禮罷。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Yelü Anli was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Yelü Anli left office.

sentences.zh: 參知政事李通以憂制，起復如故。

translations.literal: Participation Councillor Li Tong, in mourning garb, was recalled to his former post.
translations.idiomatic: Participation Councillor Li Tong, still in mourning, was recalled from bereavement to his old post.

sentences.zh: 詔左丞相張浩、參知政事敬嗣暉營建南京宮室。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Left Grand Councillor Zhang Hao and Participation Councillor Jing Sihui to build the Southern Capital palace.
translations.idiomatic: An edict put Left Grand Councillor Zhang Hao and Participation Councillor Jing Sihui in charge of building the Southern Capital palace.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，以樞密副使張暉爲尚書左丞。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on yimao, Privy Vice Commissioner Zhang Hui was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yimao, Privy Vice Commissioner Zhang Hui became Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 歸德尹致仕高召和式起爲樞密副使。

translations.literal: Retired Guiding Virtue intendant Gao Zhaoheshi was recalled as privy vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Zhaoheshi, retired intendant of Guiding Virtue, was brought back as privy vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 九月，以翰林待制完顏達紀爲高麗生日使，宿直將軍加古撻懶爲夏國生日使。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Hanlin awaiting appointment Wanyan Daji was made birthday envoy to Goryeo; duty officer of the palace guard Jagur Talan was made birthday envoy to Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Hanlin awaiting appointment Wanyan Daji was sent as birthday envoy to Goryeo and palace-guard duty officer Jagur Talan as birthday envoy to Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 十月乙亥，獵于近郊，觀造船于通州。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on yihai, he hunted in the near suburbs and inspected shipbuilding at Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on yihai, he hunted near the capital and went to Tongzhou to watch ships being built.

sentences.zh: 賜尚書右丞紇石烈良弼、樞密副使徒單貞佩刀入宮。

translations.literal: Right Vice Director Heishilie Liangbi and Privy Vice Commissioner Tushan Zhen were granted swords to enter the palace bearing arms.
translations.idiomatic: Right Vice Director Heishilie Liangbi and Privy Vice Commissioner Tushan Zhen were allowed to wear swords inside the palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲辰，以翰林侍講學士施宜生等爲賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiachen, Hanlin exposition academician Shi Yisheng and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiachen, Hanlin exposition academician Shi Yisheng and others were sent to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，宋遣使告母韋氏哀。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on yimao, Song sent envoys announcing mourning for the mother, Lady Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yimao, Song sent envoys to announce mourning for Empress Dowager Wei.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Venus was seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以左副點檢大懷忠等爲宋弔祭使。

translations.literal: On yichou, Left Deputy Director of Inspection Dai Huaizhong and others were made Song mourning envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Left Deputy Director of Inspection Dai Huaizhong and others were sent as envoys of condolence to Song.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，太醫使祁宰上疏諫伐宋，殺之。

translations.literal: On yihai, Imperial Medical Commissioner Qi Zai memorialized urging against attacking Song and was put to death.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Imperial Medical Commissioner Qi Zai submitted a memorial opposing war on Song and was executed.

sentences.zh: 五年正月庚辰朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Fifth year, first month, on gengchen new moon, Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on gengchen, the first month’s new moon, Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent New Year envoys.

sentences.zh: 乙未，生辰，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On yiwei, his birthday; Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, his birthday, Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，宋遣使獻母后遣留物。

translations.literal: Second month, on renzi, Song sent envoys presenting the late empress dowager’s bequests.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renzi, Song sent envoys with gifts left by the late empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Venus was seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 辛未，河東、陝西地震，鎮戎、德順軍大風，壞廬舍，人多壓死。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Hedong and Shaanxi were shaken by earthquake; at Zhenrong and Deshun garrisons great winds wrecked houses and many were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei earthquakes struck Hedong and Shaanxi; at Zhenrong and Deshun garrisons violent winds destroyed dwellings and buried many alive.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，遣引進使高植、刑部郎中海狗分道監視所獲盜賊，並淩遲處死，或鋸灼去皮截手足。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Introducing Commissioner Gao Zhi and Ministry of Punishments bureau director Haigou were sent on separate routes to oversee captured bandits—all were put to death by slicing, or sawed, burned, flayed, and had hands and feet cut off.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Introducing Commissioner Gao Zhi and Ministry of Punishments bureau director Haigou were dispatched on separate circuits to supervise captured bandits; all were executed by slicing, or sawn, burned, flayed, and mutilated.

sentences.zh: 仍戒屯戍千戶謀克等，後有獲者，並處死，總管府官亦決罰。

translations.literal: They were also warned that garrison commanders, company officers, and the like who later captured such men must likewise execute them, and route headquarters officials would be punished by judicial beating.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison commanders, company officers, and the like were warned that any bandits they took hereafter must also be killed on the spot, and route headquarters officials would face judicial beating.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，東海縣民張旺、徐元等反，遣都水監徐文、步軍指揮使張弘信、同知大興尹事李惟忠、宿直將軍蕭阿窊率舟師九百，浮海討之，命之曰：「朕意不在一邑，將試舟師耳。

translations.literal: Third month, on xinsi, the people of Donghai county, Zhang Wang and Xu Yuan, and others rebelled; Commissioner of Waterways Xu Wen, Infantry Commander Zhang Hongxin, Acting Daxing intendant Li Weizhong, and palace-guard duty officer Xiao A’wa led nine hundred warships by sea to suppress them. He charged them, saying: “My aim is not one county—I mean to try out the fleet.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinsi, Zhang Wang, Xu Yuan, and others rose in Donghai county; Commissioner of Waterways Xu Wen, Infantry Commander Zhang Hongxin, Acting Daxing intendant Li Weizhong, and palace-guard duty officer Xiao A’wa took nine hundred warships to sea against them. He told them, “I do not care about one county—I mean to test the fleet.

sentences.zh: 」庚子，以司徒判大宗正事蕭玉爲御史大夫，司徒如故，尚書右丞紇石烈良弼爲左丞，橫海軍節度使致仕劉長言起爲右丞。

translations.literal: ” On gengzi, Minister of Education and concurrent chief of the Imperial Clan Court Xiao Yu was made censor-in-chief, his ministerial title unchanged; Right Vice Director Heishilie Liangbi was made left vice director; retired Transverse Sea Army military commissioner Liu Zhangyan was recalled as right vice director.
translations.idiomatic: ” On gengzi Minister of Education Xiao Yu, still chief of the Imperial Clan Court, became censor-in-chief; Right Vice Director Heishilie Liangbi became left vice director; retired Transverse Sea Army military commissioner Liu Zhangyan was recalled as right vice director.

sentences.zh: 四月庚戌，昭妃蒲察阿里忽有罪賜死。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on gengxu, Consort Pucha Alihu, guilty of a crime, was granted death.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on gengxu, Consort Pucha Alihu, convicted of an offense, was ordered to take her own life.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，宿州防禦使耶律翼使宋失體，杖二百，除名。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Suzhou defense commissioner Yelü Yi, as envoy to Song, behaved without propriety and was beaten two hundred strokes and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Yelü Yi, defense commissioner of Suzhou, disgraced himself on an embassy to Song and was thrashed two hundred strokes and stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Venus was seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 六月，徐文等破賊張旺、徐元，東海平。

translations.literal: Sixth month: Xu Wen and the others defeated the bandits Zhang Wang and Xu Yuan, and Donghai was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Xu Wen and his force broke Zhang Wang and Xu Yuan; Donghai was pacified.

sentences.zh: 七月辛巳，詔東海縣徐元、張旺詿誤者，並釋之。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on xinsi, an edict released those in Donghai county whom Xu Yuan and Zhang Wang had misled.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinsi, an edict freed everyone in Donghai county whom Xu Yuan and Zhang Wang had led astray.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以張弘信被命討賊，稱疾逗遛萊州，與妓樂飲燕，杖之二百。

translations.literal: On renwu, because Zhang Hongxin, though charged to suppress the rebels, pleaded illness and lingered at Laizhou drinking and feasting with singing girls, he was beaten two hundred strokes.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Zhang Hongxin, though ordered to fight the rebels, claimed illness and dallied at Laizhou with entertainers; he was thrashed two hundred strokes.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，遣使簽諸路漢軍。

translations.literal: On guimao, envoys were sent to muster Han troops on every route.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao envoys were sent to register Han soldiers on every circuit.

sentences.zh: 八月丙午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on bingwu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingwu, the new moon brought a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命榷貨務並印造鈔引庫起赴南京。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the Monopoly Goods Office and the note-printing depot were ordered to move to the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the Monopoly Goods Office and the note-printing depot were ordered transferred to the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 己巳，樞密副使徒單貞罷，以太子少保徒單永年爲樞密副使。

translations.literal: On jisi, Privy Vice Commissioner Tushan Zhen was dismissed; Crown Prince Junior Tutor Tushan Yongnian was made privy vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Privy Vice Commissioner Tushan Zhen left office; Crown Prince Junior Tutor Tushan Yongnian became privy vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛未，謁山陵，見田間獲者，問其豐耗，以衣賜之。

translations.literal: On xinwei, he visited the imperial tombs; seeing harvesters in the fields, he asked whether the crop was plentiful or lean and gave them clothing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he went to the imperial tombs; meeting reapers in the fields, he asked whether the harvest was full or thin and bestowed clothes on them.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，還宮。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on jimao, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jimao, he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 十月庚午，遣護衛完顏普連等二十四人督捕山東、河東、河北、中都盜賊。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on gengwu, twenty-four guards including Wanyan Pulian were sent to hunt down bandits in Shandong, Hedong, Hebei, and the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on gengwu, twenty-four guards led by Wanyan Pulian were dispatched to pursue bandits through Shandong, Hedong, Hebei, and the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 籍諸路水手得三萬人。

translations.literal: Sailors registered on every route came to thirty thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: A register of sailors on every circuit yielded thirty thousand men.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，以濟南尹僕散烏者等爲賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on yiyou, Jinan intendant Pusan Wuzhe and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yiyou, Jinan intendant Pusan Wuzhe and others were sent to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.

sentences.zh: 尚書右丞劉長言罷。

translations.literal: Right Vice Director Liu Zhangyan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Right Vice Director Liu Zhangyan left office.

sentences.zh: 命親軍司以所掌付大興府。

translations.literal: The Imperial Guard Office was ordered to hand its duties over to Daxing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Guard Office was ordered to transfer its jurisdiction to Daxing prefecture.

sentences.zh: 置左右驍騎都副指揮使，隸點檢司。

translations.literal: Left and right deputy commanders of the Valiant Cavalry were established, subordinate to the Inspection Office.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy commanders of the left and right Valiant Cavalry were created, under the Inspection Office.

sentences.zh: 步軍都副指揮使，隸宣徽院。

translations.literal: Deputy commanders of the Infantry were established, subordinate to the Palace Service Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy commanders of the Infantry were created, under the Palace Service Commission.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸丑，禁中都、河北、山東、河南、河東、京兆軍民綱捕禽獸及畜養雕隼者。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on guichou, the Central Capital, Hebei, Shandong, Henan, Hedong, Jingzhao, soldiers and civilians were forbidden to net wild beasts or keep hawks and falcons.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guichou, soldiers and civilians of the Central Capital, Hebei, Shandong, Henan, Hedong, and Jingzhao were forbidden to hunt wild animals or keep hawks and falcons.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，禁朝官飲酒，犯者死，三國人使燕飲者罪。

translations.literal: On wuchen, court officials were forbidden to drink wine; violators were put to death, and envoys of the three states who feasted them in Yan were also punished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen drinking was banned for court officials on pain of death, and envoys of the three kingdoms who entertained them in Yan were liable as well.

sentences.zh: 六年正月甲戌朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Sixth year, first month, on jiaxu new moon, Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on jiaxu, the first month’s new moon, Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent New Year envoys.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，判大宗正徒單貞、益都尹京、安武軍節度使爽、金吾衛上將軍阿速飲酒，以近屬故，杖貞七十，餘皆杖百。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Chief of the Imperial Clan Court Tushan Zhen, Yidu intendant Jing, Anwu Army military commissioner Shuang, and Golden Crow Guard senior general Asu drank wine; as close kin, Zhen was beaten seventy strokes and the rest a hundred each.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Tushan Zhen, chief of the Imperial Clan Court, Yidu intendant Jing, Anwu Army military commissioner Shuang, and Golden Crow Guard senior general Asu were caught drinking; as a near kinsman Zhen took seventy strokes and the others a hundred each.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上將如南京，以司徒、御史大夫蕭玉爲大興尹，司徒如故。

translations.literal: On renwu, the emperor was about to go to the Southern Capital; Minister of Education and Censor-in-Chief Xiao Yu was made Daxing intendant, his ministerial title unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, as the emperor prepared to visit the Southern Capital, Minister of Education and Censor-in-Chief Xiao Yu was named Daxing intendant while keeping his ministerial rank.

sentences.zh: 樞密副使徒單永年罷，以都點檢紇石烈志寧爲樞密副使。

translations.literal: Privy Vice Commissioner Tushan Yongnian was dismissed; Chief Inspector Heishilie Zhining was made privy vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Privy Vice Commissioner Tushan Yongnian left office; Chief Inspector Heishilie Zhining became privy vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己丑，生辰，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On jichou, his birthday; Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, his birthday, Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命參知政事李通諭宋使徐度等曰：「朕昔從梁王軍，樂南京風土，常欲巡幸。

translations.literal: On guisi, Participation Councillor Li Tong instructed the Song envoys Xu Du and the others, saying: “Long ago, when I followed Prince of Liang’s army, I delighted in the Southern Capital’s air and soil and have often wished to tour there.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Participation Councillor Li Tong told the Song envoys Xu Du and the rest, “Years ago, marching with Prince of Liang’s host, I came to love the Southern Capital’s climate and have long wanted to visit.

sentences.zh: 今營繕將畢功，期以二月末先往河南。

translations.literal: Now construction and repair will soon be completed; we set a date at the end of the second month to go first to Henan.
translations.idiomatic: The palace works are nearly finished; we mean to set out for Henan at the end of the second month.

sentences.zh: 帝王巡守，自古有之。

translations.literal: Imperial tours of inspection have existed since antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Emperors touring the realm is an ancient practice.

sentences.zh: 以淮右多隙地，欲校獵其間，從兵不逾萬人。

translations.literal: Because south of the Huai has much vacant land, I wish to hunt there; the escort will not exceed ten thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: The country south of the Huai still has wide empty ground, so I mean to hunt there with no more than ten thousand men in my train.

sentences.zh: 況朕祖宗陵廟在此，安能久于彼乎。

translations.literal: Moreover, the tombs and temples of my ancestors are here—how could I stay long in that place?
translations.idiomatic: Besides, my forebears’ tombs and temples are here; I could not remain there for long.

sentences.zh: 汝等歸告汝主，令有司宣諭朕意，使淮南之民無懷疑懼。

translations.literal: You should return and tell your lord; let officials proclaim my intent so the people of Huainan harbor no doubt or fear.
translations.idiomatic: Go back and report to your sovereign; have his officials explain my purpose so the people of Huainan need not doubt or fear.

sentences.zh: 」庚子，詔自中都至河南府所過州縣調從獵騎士二千。

translations.literal: ” On gengzi, an edict ordered the prefectures and counties along the route from the Central Capital to Henan prefecture to levy two thousand hunting cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: ” On gengzi an edict required every prefecture and county between the Central Capital and Henan to supply two thousand mounted hunters for the train.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，殺蒲察阿虎迭女義察。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Pucha Ahudie’s daughter Yicha was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Yicha, daughter of Pucha Ahudie, was put to death.

sentences.zh: 義察，慶宜公主出，幼鞠宮中，上屢欲納之，太后不可。

translations.literal: Yicha, born of Princess Qingyi, was raised young in the palace; the emperor repeatedly wished to take her as consort, but the empress dowager would not allow it.
translations.idiomatic: Yicha, Princess Qingyi’s daughter, had been reared in the palace from childhood; the emperor often wanted to make her a consort, but the empress dowager refused.

sentences.zh: 至是，以罪殺之。

translations.literal: At this time she was killed on a charge.
translations.idiomatic: Now she was executed on a criminal charge.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，杖衛王襄之妃及左宣徽使許霖。

translations.literal: Second month, on yisi, the consort of Wei Prince Xiang and Left Director of the Palace Service Xu Lin were beaten with the staff.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yisi, Wei Prince Xiang’s consort and Left Director of the Palace Service Xu Lin were flogged.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以參知政事李通爲尚書右丞。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Participation Councillor Li Tong was made Right Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Participation Councillor Li Tong became Right Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 己未，禁扈從縱獵擾民。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the escort was forbidden to hunt freely and harass the people.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei followers on the tour were forbidden to hunt at will or trouble the populace.

sentences.zh: 庚申，征諸道水手運戰船。

translations.literal: On gengshen, sailors from every circuit were mobilized to transport war ships.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen sailors from all circuits were conscripted to move warships.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，發中都。

translations.literal: On guihai, he departed the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he left the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，次安肅州。

translations.literal: On bingyin, he halted at Ansu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he made camp at Ansu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，改河南北邙山爲太平山，稱舊名者以違制論。

translations.literal: Third month, on jimao, Mount Mang north of Henan was renamed Mount Taiping; using the old name was punished as a violation of regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jimao, Mount Mang north of Henan was retitled Mount Taiping, and anyone who used the old name was charged with violating an edict.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，將至獲嘉，有男子上書言事，斬之，所言莫得聞。

translations.literal: On dinghai, as he was about to reach Huojia, a man submitted a memorial; he was beheaded, and what he said was never heard.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, nearing Huojia, a man presented a written appeal; he was executed at once, and his words never came to light.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，次河南府，因出獵，幸汝州溫湯，視行宮地。

translations.literal: On guisi, he halted at Henan prefecture, went out hunting, visited the hot springs of Ruzhou, and inspected the site for a traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he encamped at Henan prefecture, hunted, went to the Ruzhou hot springs, and surveyed ground for a touring palace.

sentences.zh: 自中都至河南，所過麥皆爲空。

translations.literal: From the Central Capital to Henan, the wheat in every place they passed was stripped bare.
translations.idiomatic: All the wheat along the road from the Central Capital to Henan was eaten or trampled away.

sentences.zh: 復禁扈從毋輒離次及遊賞飲酒，犯者罪皆死，而莫有從者。

translations.literal: Again the escort was forbidden to leave ranks without permission or to go sightseeing and drink wine; all offenders were sentenced to death, yet none obeyed.
translations.idiomatic: He again forbade the train to leave formation or go off to sightsee and drink on pain of death, but no one heeded it.

sentences.zh: 詔內地諸猛安赴山后牧馬，俟秋併發。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the interior meng’an to go beyond the mountains to pasture horses and wait until autumn to set out together.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent the interior meng’an units to pasture horses north of the ranges and gather for a joint departure in autumn.

sentences.zh: 弟袞之妻烏延氏有罪，賜死。

translations.literal: His younger brother Gun’s wife, of the Wuyan clan, was guilty and granted death.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Gun’s wife, a Wuyan, was found guilty and ordered to take her own life.

sentences.zh: 烏延氏之弟南京兵馬副都指揮使習泥烈亦以罪誅。

translations.literal: The Wuyan woman’s younger brother, Nanjing deputy commander of armies and cavalry Xinilie, was also executed for a crime.
translations.idiomatic: Her brother Xinilie, Nanjing’s deputy commander of armies and cavalry, was likewise put to death for his crimes.

sentences.zh: 四月丁未，詔百官先赴南京治事，尚書省、樞密院、大宗正府、勸農司、太府、少府皆從行，吏、戶、兵、刑部，四方館，都水監，大理司官各留一員。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on dingwei, an edict ordered all officials to go first to the Southern Capital to conduct government; the Secretariat, Bureau of Military Affairs, Imperial Clan Court, Office for Encouraging Agriculture, Grand Storehouse, and Palace Workshops all accompanied him, while the ministries of Personnel, Revenue, War, and Justice, the Four Directions Hostel, the Directorate of Waterways, and the Court of Judicial Review each left one officer behind.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on dingwei, an edict sent the whole bureaucracy ahead to govern at the Southern Capital; the Secretariat, Privy Bureau, Imperial Clan Court, agriculture office, Grand Storehouse, and Palace Workshops traveled with him, but the four ministries, the Four Directions Hostel, the Directorate of Waterways, and the Court of Judicial Review each kept one officer in place.

sentences.zh: 以簽書樞密院事高景山等爲賀宋生日使。

translations.literal: Gao Jingshan, deputy signing Privy Bureau affairs, and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the birthday.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy signing Privy Bureau affairs Gao Jingshan and others were sent as birthday envoys to Song.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔汝州百五十里內州縣，量遣商賈赴溫湯置市。

translations.literal: On wushen, an edict ordered the prefectures and counties within a hundred and fifty li of Ruzhou to send merchants in due measure to the hot springs to set up markets.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen an edict told every prefecture and county within a hundred and fifty li of Ruzhou to dispatch traders to open markets at the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 詔有司移問宋人，蔡、穎、壽諸州對境創置堡戍者。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the offices to send a formal inquiry to the Song, concerning those who had newly built fortresses and garrisons on the border opposite Cai, Ying, and Shou prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered officials to demand of Song why new forts and posts had been raised along the borders of Cai, Ying, and Shou.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，發河南府。

translations.literal: On gengxu, he departed Henan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he marched out of Henan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 契丹不補自山馳下，伏道左，自陳破東海賊有功，爲李惟忠所抑，立命斬之。

translations.literal: The Khitan Bubu galloped down from the hills, prostrated himself on the left of the road, and declared that he had merit in defeating the Donghai bandits but had been suppressed by Li Weizhong; he was ordered beheaded on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan Bubu rode down from the hills and kowtowed by the roadside, claiming credit for crushing the Donghai rebels yet being thwarted by Li Weizhong; the emperor had him cut down at once.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，次溫湯。

translations.literal: On dingmao, he halted at the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he encamped at the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 誡扈從毋輒過汝水。

translations.literal: He admonished the escort not to cross the Ru River without permission.
translations.idiomatic: He warned the train not to cross the Ru River without leave.

sentences.zh: 上獵，奔鹿突之墮馬，嘔血數日。

translations.literal: While the emperor was hunting, a fleeing stag charged him; he fell from his horse and vomited blood for several days.
translations.idiomatic: On the hunt a stag running amok knocked him from his horse; he spat blood for days afterward.

sentences.zh: 遣使征諸道兵。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to levy troops from every circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He dispatched envoys to mobilize armies in every circuit.

sentences.zh: 七月丁亥，以左丞相張浩爲太傅、尚書令，司徒、大興尹蕭玉爲尚書左丞相，吏部尚書白彥恭爲樞密副使，樞密副使紇石烈志甯爲開封尹，安武軍節度使徒單貞爲御史大夫。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on dinghai, Left Grand Councillor Zhang Hao was made Grand Tutor and Director of the Secretariat; Minister of Education and Daxing intendant Xiao Yu was made Left Grand Councillor; Minister of Personnel Bai Yanchong was made Privy Vice Commissioner; Privy Vice Commissioner Heishilie Zhining was made Kaifeng intendant; and Anwu Army military commissioner Tushan Zhen was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on dinghai, Left Grand Councillor Zhang Hao became Grand Tutor and Director of the Secretariat; Minister of Education and Daxing intendant Xiao Yu became Left Grand Councillor; Minister of Personnel Bai Yanchong became Privy Vice Commissioner; Privy Vice Commissioner Heishilie Zhining became Kaifeng intendant; and Anwu Army military commissioner Tushan Zhen became Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 己丑，賜從駕、從行、從軍及千戶謀克錢帛。

translations.literal: On jichou, those in the imperial escort, the traveling party, the army, and the chiliarchs and meng’an chiefs were granted money and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he rewarded everyone in the imperial train, the marchers, the troops, and the chiliarchs and meng’an chiefs with cash and silks.

sentences.zh: 大括天下羸馬。

translations.literal: A great roundup of emaciated horses was made throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The court launched an empire-wide drive to seize every weak horse.

sentences.zh: 殺亡遼耶律氏、宋趙氏子男凡百三十餘人。

translations.literal: More than a hundred and thirty men and boys of the defunct Liao Yelü clan and the Song Zhao clan were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Over a hundred and thirty male descendants of the fallen Liao Yelü house and the Song Zhao house were put to death.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，單州賊杜奎據城叛，遣都點檢耶律湛、右驍騎副都指揮大磐討之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on renyin, the bandit Du Kui seized Shan prefecture in revolt; Chief Inspector Yelü Zhan and Right Valiant Cavalry Deputy Commander Da Pan were sent to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renyin, Du Kui rebelled and held Shan prefecture; Chief Inspector Yelü Zhan and Right Valiant Cavalry Deputy Commander Da Pan were dispatched against him.

sentences.zh: 以樞密副使白彥恭爲北面兵馬都統，開封尹紇石烈志寧副之，中都留守完顏彀英爲西北面兵馬都統，西北路招討使唐括孛古的副之，討契丹。

translations.literal: Privy Vice Commissioner Bai Yanchong was made commander-in-chief of northern armies and cavalry, with Privy Commissioner Heishilie Zhining as his deputy; Central Capital defender Wanyan Guyin was made commander-in-chief of northwestern armies and cavalry, with Northwestern Route pacification commissioner Tangguo Bogude as his deputy, to suppress the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: Privy Vice Commissioner Bai Yanchong took command of the northern armies with Privy Commissioner Heishilie Zhining as deputy; Central Capital defender Wanyan Guyin commanded the northwest with Northwestern Route pacification commissioner Tangguo Bogude as deputy, both columns sent to crush the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以諫伐宋弑皇太后徒單氏于甯德宮，仍命即宮中焚之，棄其骨水中，並殺其侍婢等十餘人。

translations.literal: On guichou, the empress dowager of the Tushan clan, who had remonstrated against attacking Song, was confined in Ningde Palace; she was ordered burned in the palace at once, her bones cast into the water, and more than ten of her serving maids were also killed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Empress Dowager Tushan, who had opposed war on Song, was shut in Ningde Palace, then ordered burned where she lay; her bones were thrown into the river, and a dozen of her maids were killed with her.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，殺右衛將軍蕭禿剌、護衛十人長斡盧保，族樞密使僕散思恭、北京留守蕭賾、西京留守蕭懷忠，杖尚書令張浩、左丞相蕭玉。

translations.literal: On guihai, Right Guards general Xiao Tula and ten-man captain of the guards Wulubao were killed; Privy Commissioner Pusan Sigong, Beijing intendant Xiao Ze, and Western Capital intendant Xiao Huaizhong were executed to the third degree; and Director of the Secretariat Zhang Hao and Left Grand Councillor Xiao Yu were beaten with the staff.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Right Guards general Xiao Tula and guards captain Wulubao were executed; Privy Commissioner Pusan Sigong and the Beijing and Western Capital intendants Xiao Ze and Xiao Huaizhong were wiped out to the third degree of kin; and Director of the Secretariat Zhang Hao and Left Grand Councillor Xiao Yu were flogged.

sentences.zh: 乙太常博士張崇爲高麗生日使，蕭誼忠爲夏國生日使。

translations.literal: Ceremonial academician Zhang Chong was made Goryeo birthday envoy; Xiao Yizhong was made Western Xia birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremonial academician Zhang Chong was sent as birthday envoy to Goryeo, and Xiao Yizhong to Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 甲子，封所幸太后侍婢高福娘爲鄖國夫人。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the palace maid Gao Funiang, whom he favored, was ennobled as Lady of the State of E.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Gao Funiang, a maid of the empress dowager whom he favored, was created Lady of E.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午朔，乙太保、判大宗正事昂爲樞密使，太保如故。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on gengwu, the new moon; Grand Mentor and acting chief of the Imperial Clan Court Ang was made Privy Commissioner, his rank of Grand Mentor unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the new moon of the ninth month, Grand Mentor Ang, who also headed the Imperial Clan Court, became Privy Commissioner while keeping his grand mentor title.

sentences.zh: 戊子，殺前壽州刺史毛良虎。

translations.literal: On wuzi, former prefect of Shou Mao Lianghu was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Mao Lianghu, former prefect of Shou, was executed.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，大名府賊王九據城叛，衆至數萬，所至盜賊峰起，大者連城邑，小者保山澤，或以十數騎張旗幟而行，官軍莫敢近。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the bandit Wang Jiu seized Daming prefecture in revolt; his followers rose to tens of thousands, and wherever he went bandits flared up—the great ones held whole cities and towns, the small ones sheltered in hills and marshes, and some rode a dozen horses under banners while government troops dared not approach.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Wang Jiu rebelled and took Daming; his host swelled to tens of thousands, and bandits erupted everywhere he passed—some seized towns, others hid in hills and swamps, and parties of a dozen horsemen with banners roamed while official armies shrank from them.

sentences.zh: 上又惡聞盜賊事，言者輒罪之。

translations.literal: The emperor also hated to hear of banditry; whoever spoke of it was punished.
translations.idiomatic: He likewise could not bear reports of brigands; anyone who raised the subject was punished.

sentences.zh: 上自將三十二總管兵伐宋，進自壽春。

translations.literal: The emperor himself led thirty-two zongguan armies against Song, advancing from Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor took the field at the head of thirty-two zongguan hosts against Song, marching from Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 乙太保、樞密使昂爲左領軍大都督，尚書右丞李通副之，尚書左丞紇石烈良弼爲右領軍大都督，判大宗正烏延蒲盧渾副之，御史大夫徒單貞爲左監軍，同判大宗正事徒單永年爲右監軍，左宣徽使許霖爲左都監，河南尹蒲察斡論爲右都監，皆從。

translations.literal: Grand Mentor and Privy Commissioner Ang was made left supreme army commander, with Right Director of the Secretariat Li Tong as his deputy; Left Grand Councillor Heishilie Liangbi was made right supreme army commander, with acting chief of the Imperial Clan Court Wuyan Puluhun as his deputy; Censor-in-Chief Tushan Zhen was made left army overseer; Acting Chief of the Imperial Clan Court Tushan Yongnian was made right army overseer; Left Director of the Palace Service Xu Lin was made left army inspector; Henan intendant Pucha Wolun was made right army inspector—all accompanied him.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Mentor and Privy Commissioner Ang commanded the left supreme army with Right Director Li Tong as deputy; Left Grand Councillor Heishilie Liangbi commanded the right with Wuyan Puluhun of the Imperial Clan Court as deputy; Censor-in-Chief Tushan Zhen and Acting Chief Tushan Yongnian served as left and right overseers; Left Director Xu Lin and Henan intendant Pucha Wolun as left and right inspectors—all marched with him.

sentences.zh: 工部尚書蘇保衡爲浙東道水軍都統制，益都尹鄭家副之，由海道徑趨臨安。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Su Baoheng was made commander of the Zhedong circuit water army, with Yidu intendant Zheng Jia as his deputy, to strike straight for Lin’an by sea.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works Su Baoheng took command of the Zhedong water forces with Yidu intendant Zheng Jia as deputy, ordered to sail straight for Lin’an.

sentences.zh: 太原尹劉萼爲漢南道行營兵馬都統制，濟南尹僕散烏者副之，進自蔡州。

translations.literal: Taiyuan intendant Liu E was made commander-in-chief of camp armies and horses on the Han South Route; Jinan intendant Pusan Wuzhe was his deputy; they advanced from Cai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liu E, intendant of Taiyuan, took command of the Han South Route field armies; Pusan Wuzhe of Jinan served as his deputy, and they marched out from Cai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 河中尹徒單合喜爲西蜀道行營兵馬都統制，平陽尹張中彥副之，由鳳翔取散關，駐軍以俟後命。

translations.literal: Hezhong intendant Tushan Hexi was made commander-in-chief of camp armies and horses on the West Shu Route; Pingyang intendant Zhang Zhongyan was his deputy; they were to take San Pass from Fengxiang and encamp awaiting further orders.
translations.idiomatic: Tushan Hexi of Hezhong commanded the West Shu Route field armies, with Zhang Zhongyan of Pingyang as deputy; they were to seize San Pass from Fengxiang and hold there until new orders came.

sentences.zh: 武勝、武平、武捷三軍爲前鋒。

translations.literal: The three armies Victory, Peace, and Swift served as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: The Victory, Peace, and Swift armies formed the vanguard.

sentences.zh: 徒單貞別將兵二萬入淮陰。

translations.literal: Tushan Zhen separately led twenty thousand troops into Huaiyin.
translations.idiomatic: Tushan Zhen led twenty thousand men on a separate column into Huaiyin.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上發南京，詔皇后及太子光英居守，尚書令張浩、左丞相蕭玉、參知政事敬嗣暉留治省事。

translations.literal: On jiawu the emperor set out from the Southern Capital; an edict ordered the empress and Crown Prince Guang Ying to remain; Secretariat Director Zhang Hao, Left Chief Councilor Xiao Yu, and Participation Councillor Jing Sihui were left to handle routine business.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he marched from the Southern Capital. The empress and Crown Prince Guang Ying were ordered to stay behind; Zhang Hao as director of the Secretariat, Xiao Yu as left chief councilor, and Jing Sihui as participation councillor were left to run the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On bingshen Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Venus shone in broad daylight.

sentences.zh: 將士自軍中亡歸者相屬于道。

translations.literal: Soldiers fleeing the army strung along the roads without break.
translations.idiomatic: Deserters from the host filed home along the roads in an unbroken stream.

sentences.zh: 曷蘇館猛安福壽、東京謀克金住等始授甲于大名，即舉部亡歸，從者衆至萬餘，皆公言于路曰：「我輩今往東京，立新天子矣！」

translations.literal: Hasu Office meng’an Fushou, Eastern Capital mouke Jin Zhu, and others had just been issued arms at Daming when they led their units in flight homeward; followers swelled to more than ten thousand, and they said openly on the road: “We are going to the Eastern Capital to set up a new Son of Heaven!”
translations.idiomatic: Fushou, meng’an of the Hasu Office, Jin Zhu the mouke of the Eastern Capital, and others had barely been armed at Daming when they turned their commands homeward. Their following grew past ten thousand, and on the road they proclaimed without shame: “We go to the Eastern Capital to raise a new emperor!”

sentences.zh: 十月乙巳，陰迷失道，二鼓始達營所。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on yisi: lost in fog and off the road, they reached camp only at the second watch.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on yisi, fog and wrong roads held them until the second watch before they found camp.

sentences.zh: 丙午，慶雲見。

translations.literal: On bingwu auspicious clouds appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu celebratory clouds were seen.

sentences.zh: 東京留守曹國公烏祿即位于遼陽，改元大定，大赦。

translations.literal: Eastern Capital regent Duke of Cao Wulu took the throne at Liaoyang, changed the era to Dading, and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: Wulu, Duke of Cao and regent at the Eastern Capital, took the throne at Liaoyang, proclaimed the era Dading, and granted a great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 數海陵過惡：弑皇太后徒單氏，弑太宗及宗翰、宗弼子孫及宗本諸王，毀上京宮室，殺遼豫王、宋天水郡王、郡公子孫等數十事。

translations.literal: He listed Hailing’s crimes: murdering Empress Dowager Tushan; murdering Taizong and the descendants of Zonghan, Zongbi, and the princes of Zongben’s line; destroying the Supreme Capital palaces; killing the Liao Prince of Yu, Song’s Prince of Tianshui, and many sons and grandsons of princes—dozens of such deeds.
translations.idiomatic: He recited Hailing’s crimes: the murder of Empress Dowager Tushan; the slaughter of Taizong’s line and of the houses of Zonghan, Zongbi, and Zongben; the wrecking of the Supreme Capital palaces; the killing of the Liao Prince of Yu, Song’s Prince of Tianshui, and scores of princely kin—dozens of counts in all.

sentences.zh: 丁未，大軍渡淮，將至廬州，獲白鹿，以爲武王白魚之兆。

translations.literal: On dingwei the main army crossed the Huai; nearing Luzhou they captured a white deer, taking it as the omen of King Wu’s white fish.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the main host forded the Huai. Near Luzhou they took a white deer and read it as King Wu’s white-fish sign.

sentences.zh: 漢南道劉萼取通化軍、蔣州、信陽軍。

translations.literal: Liu E on the Han South Route took Tonghua Army, Jiang Prefecture, and Xinyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the Han South Route Liu E seized Tonghua Army, Jiang Prefecture, and Xinyang Army.

sentences.zh: 徒單貞敗宋將王權于盱眙，進取揚州。

translations.literal: Tushan Zhen defeated Song commander Wang Quan at Xuyi and advanced to take Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Tushan Zhen broke Song’s Wang Quan at Xuyi and pressed on toward Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 前鋒軍至段寨，宋戍兵皆遁去，敗宋兵于蔚子橋，敗宋兵于巢縣，斬二百級，至和州。

translations.literal: The vanguard reached Duan Stockade; Song garrison troops all fled; they defeated Song at Yuzi Bridge, defeated Song at Chaoxian, beheaded two hundred, and reached Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: The vanguard came to Duan Stockade; the Song garrison melted away. They routed Song at Yuzi Bridge and again at Chaoxian, took two hundred heads, and marched to Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 王權夜以兵千餘來襲，射卻之。

translations.literal: Wang Quan raided by night with over a thousand men; they were driven back by archery.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Quan struck by night with more than a thousand men and was beaten back by bowshot.

sentences.zh: 翼日，雨。

translations.literal: The next day it rained.
translations.idiomatic: The next day rain fell.

sentences.zh: 宋人夜焚其積遁去。

translations.literal: The Song burned their stores by night and fled.
translations.idiomatic: By night the Song fired their granaries and slipped away.

sentences.zh: 詰旦追之，宋人逆戰，猛安韓棠軍卻，遂失利。

translations.literal: At dawn they pursued; the Song met them in battle; meng’an Han Tang’s unit broke, and they suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: At first light they gave chase. The Song turned to fight; Han Tang’s meng’an column gave way, and the day turned to loss.

sentences.zh: 溫都奧剌奔北，武捷軍副總管阿散率猛安謀克力戰，卻之。

translations.literal: Wendu Olucha fled north; Swift Army deputy commander Asan led meng’an and mouke in fierce fighting and repulsed the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Wendu Olucha ran north, but Asan, deputy commander of the Swift Army, rallied the meng’an and mouke in a hard fight and threw the enemy back.

sentences.zh: 王權退保南岸。

translations.literal: Wang Quan withdrew to hold the south bank.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Quan fell back to guard the south bank.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上次和州，阿散等進階賞賚有差。

translations.literal: On guihai the emperor reached Hezhou; Asan and the others were promoted and rewarded in differing degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the emperor came to Hezhou. Asan and his fellows were raised in rank and rewarded each according to merit.

sentences.zh: 西蜀道徒單合喜駐散關，宋人攻秦州臘家城、德順州，克之。

translations.literal: Tushan Hexi on the West Shu Route held San Pass; the Song attacked Lajia Castle in Qin Prefecture and Deshun Prefecture and took them.
translations.idiomatic: On the West Shu Route Tushan Hexi held San Pass while Song forces stormed Lajia Castle in Qinzhou and Deshun Prefecture and carried both.

sentences.zh: 浙東道蘇保衡與宋人戰于海道，敗績，副統制鄭家死之。

translations.literal: Su Baoheng on the Zhedong Route fought the Song on the sea route, suffered defeat, and deputy commander Zheng Jia died.
translations.idiomatic: Su Baoheng on the Zhedong Route met Song fleets on the sea, was beaten, and his deputy Zheng Jia fell in the fight.

sentences.zh: 海陵在位十餘年，每飾情貌以御臣下。

translations.literal: Hailing had been on the throne more than ten years, constantly adorning his manner to control his ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Hailing reigned more than ten years, forever polishing his face to rule those below.

sentences.zh: 卻尚食進鵝以示儉，及遊獵頓次，不時需索，一鵝一鶉，民間或用數萬售之，有以一牛易一鶉者。

translations.literal: He refused roast goose from the imperial kitchen to show frugality; yet on hunts and halts he demanded at odd times—one goose or one quail might cost the people tens of thousands; some traded an ox for a single quail.
translations.idiomatic: He waved away roast goose from the imperial kitchen to play the frugal ruler, yet on hunt and halt he demanded at whim: a single goose or quail might cost the people tens of thousands, and some paid an ox for one quail.

sentences.zh: 或以弊衾覆衣，以示近臣。

translations.literal: He would cover clothes with a tattered quilt to show close ministers.
translations.idiomatic: He draped fine robes with a ragged quilt for his intimates to see.

sentences.zh: 或服補綴，令記注官見之。

translations.literal: Or wear patched garments and let the recorders witness it.
translations.idiomatic: Or went in patched dress so the diarists could write it down.

sentences.zh: 或取軍士陳米飯與尚食同進，先食軍士飯幾盡。

translations.literal: Or took soldiers’ old rice and ate with the imperial kitchen, consuming almost all the soldiers’ rice first.
translations.idiomatic: Or shared the soldiers’ stale rice with the imperial kitchen and ate their fill of the soldiers’ bowls before his own.

sentences.zh: 或見民車陷泥澤，令衛士下挽，俟車出然後行。

translations.literal: Or seeing a civilian cart stuck in mud, he ordered guards to wade and pull until the cart was free before he moved on.
translations.idiomatic: Or, seeing a commoner’s cart mired, made his guards wade into the muck and haul until the wheels cleared—only then would he pass.

sentences.zh: 與近臣燕語，輒引古昔賢君以自況。

translations.literal: In banter with close ministers he constantly cited ancient sages as his mirror.
translations.idiomatic: In talk with favorites he measured himself against the sage-kings of old.

sentences.zh: 顯責大臣，使進直言。

translations.literal: He sternly reproached great ministers, urging frank speech.
translations.idiomatic: He scolded his great ministers and demanded blunt counsel.

sentences.zh: 使張仲軻輩爲諫官，而祁宰竟以直諫死。

translations.literal: He made Zhang Zhongke and others remonstrance officers, yet Qi Zai died for frank counsel after all.
translations.idiomatic: He set Zhang Zhongke and others to remonstrate—yet Qi Zai was killed for speaking plain truth.

sentences.zh: 比昵群小，官賞無度，左右有曠僚者，人或以名呼之，即授以顯階。

translations.literal: Yet he favored petty men without limit on offices and rewards; if someone in his entourage had an idle post and people called him by name, he would grant a high rank at once.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he clung to sycophants and spent offices without measure. A courtier with no real post, if men hailed him by name in jest, might walk away with a lofty rank that same hour.

sentences.zh: 常置黃金裀褥間，有喜之者，令自取之。

translations.literal: He kept gold in his bedding; whoever pleased him might take it himself.
translations.idiomatic: He strewed gold in his bedding; whoever pleased him was told to help himself.

sentences.zh: 而淫嬖不擇骨肉，刑殺不問有罪。

translations.literal: Yet his lusts knew no kinship, and executions asked no guilt.
translations.idiomatic: His lusts spared no kin, and his killings asked no crime.

sentences.zh: 至營南京宮殿，運一木之費至二千萬，牽一車之力至五百人。

translations.literal: When building the Southern Capital palace, moving one timber could cost twenty million; pulling one cart might take five hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: To raise the Southern Capital palaces, a single log might cost twenty million cash; a single cart might need five hundred haulers.

sentences.zh: 宮殿之飾，遍傅黃金而後間以五采，金屑飛空如落雪。

translations.literal: Palace ornament: all gold leaf first, then colored inlay—gold dust flew like falling snow.
translations.idiomatic: Halls were gilded first and only then touched with color; gold dust hung in the air like snow.

sentences.zh: 一殿之費以億萬計，成而復毀，務極華麗。

translations.literal: A single hall cost hundreds of millions; once finished it was destroyed again—he pursued only splendor.
translations.idiomatic: One hall could run to a hundred million; finished halls were torn down and begun again—he wanted only excess.

sentences.zh: 其南征造戰艦江上，毀民廬舍以爲材，煮死人膏以爲油，殫民力如馬牛，費財用如土苴，空國以圖人國，遂至于敗。

translations.literal: On the southern campaign he built warships on the Yangtze, tore down houses for timber, boiled human fat for oil, exhausted the people like cattle, spent treasure like dirt, emptied the state to seize another state—and thus to ruin.
translations.idiomatic: For the southern war he built warships on the Yangtze, stripped homes for timber, boiled human fat for lamp-oil, drove the people like oxen and spent treasure like dust, hollowed the realm to swallow another—and so came to ruin.

sentences.zh: 都督府以其柩置之南京班荊館。

translations.literal: The commandery placed his coffin in the Bandiao Hostel at the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: The commandery set his coffin in the Bandiao Hostel at the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 大定二年，降封爲海陵郡王，諡曰煬。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dading he was demoted to Prince of Hailing commandery; his posthumous title was Yang.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading year 2 he was lowered to Prince of Hailing commandery and given the posthumous name Yang.

sentences.zh: 二月，世宗使小底婁室與南京官遷其柩于甯德宮。

translations.literal: In the second month Shizong sent petty attendant Loushi and Southern Capital officials to move the coffin to Ningde Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Shizong sent the petty attendant Loushi with the Southern Capital officers to transfer the coffin to Ningde Palace.

sentences.zh: 四月，葬于大房山鹿門谷諸王兆域中。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he was buried in the princes’ tomb precinct at Lumen Valley on Great Fang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he was buried in the princes’ precinct at Lumen Valley on Great Fang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 二十年，熙宗既祔廟，有司奏曰：「煬王之罪未正。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, after Xizong had been enshrined in the ancestral temple, the relevant offices memorialized: “Prince Yang’s crimes have not been set right.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, once Xizong had entered the ancestral temple, the offices memorialized: “The crimes of Prince Yang remain uncorrected.

sentences.zh: 准晉趙王倫廢惠帝自立，惠帝反正，誅倫，廢爲庶人。

translations.literal: We cite Jin: the Prince of Zhao Lun deposed Emperor Hui and set himself up; when Hui was restored, Lun was executed and demoted to commoner.
translations.idiomatic: We cite the Jin precedent: Prince of Zhao Lun deposed Emperor Hui and seized the throne; when Hui was restored, Lun was killed and cast out as a commoner.

sentences.zh: 煬帝罪惡過于倫，不當有王對，亦不當在諸王塋域。

translations.literal: Prince Yang’s crimes exceeded Lun’s; he ought not to hold a princely title, nor lie in the princes’ tomb precinct.”
translations.idiomatic: Yang’s guilt outdid Lun’s. He should bear no princely rank and rest nowhere among the princes’ tombs.”

sentences.zh: 」乃詔降爲海陵庶人，改葬于山陵西南四十里。

translations.literal: An edict then demoted him to Hailing the commoner and reburied him forty li southwest of the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then stripped him to Hailing the commoner and moved his grave forty li southwest of the imperial mausolea.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：海陵智足以拒諫，言足以飾非。

translations.literal: Eulogy: Hailing had wit enough to fend off remonstrance and words enough to varnish his faults.
translations.idiomatic: Eulogy: Hailing had wit enough to turn aside counsel and tongue enough to gild his wrongs.

sentences.zh: 欲爲君則弑其君，欲伐國則弑其母，欲奪人之妻則使之殺其夫。

translations.literal: To be ruler he murdered his ruler; to attack a state he murdered his mother; to seize another’s wife he made her kill her husband.
translations.idiomatic: To become ruler he killed his ruler; to conquer a realm he killed his mother; to take another man’s wife he made her slay her husband.

sentences.zh: 三綱絕矣，何暇他論。

translations.literal: The three bonds were extinguished—what room for other talk?
translations.idiomatic: The three bonds were dead—what else was there to say?

sentences.zh: 至于屠滅宗族，剪刈忠良，婦姑姊妹盡入嬪御。

translations.literal: As for slaughtering the clan, mowing down the loyal, and taking mothers-in-law and sisters into the harem—
translations.idiomatic: He butchered his kin, mowed down the loyal, and swept mothers-in-law and sisters into the inner quarters—

sentences.zh: 方以三十二總管之兵圖一天下，卒之戾氣感召，身由惡終，使天下後世稱無道主以海陵爲首。

translations.literal: Just as he deployed thirty-two route commanders to seize all under Heaven, in the end malign vapors answered him and he died by his own evil, so that later ages name Hailing first among lawless rulers.
translations.idiomatic: He had just set thirty-two route marshals on the conquest of the world when malice answered malice and his life ended in the evil he had sown—so that later ages, naming tyrants, put Hailing at the head.

sentences.zh: 可不戒哉！

translations.literal: Let there be warning!
translations.idiomatic: Let this be a warning!
